method: Manual semantic assessment against each recorded prompt and actual changed-line chunk, using the control rubric. JSON syntax, runtime citation validation, exact expected location, causal explanation and EOS are separate. Alternative causal changed-line citations are allowed for semantic assessment when their reason is correct.
what_prefix_supplies: The findings key, a nonempty findings array and the opening of the first object/key. The positive verdict is supplied externally. Line IDs, reasons, any extra findings, closing syntax and EOS are model-generated.

comparison_to_control.conclusion: Runtime citation validity improves from 2/4 to 3/4 and exact expected location from 1/4 to 2/4. Grounded continuation success remains 1/4, on the same exact training example; its explanation becomes clearer and exact. Neither existing diagnostic has a correct causal explanation.

limits: All four inputs are concern cases and receive the positive verdict prefix externally. No autonomous concern detection, clean false-positive rate, or paired verdict success can be inferred. The learned training-target reproduction is separated from performance on existing review diagnostics.
verification_scope: Only JSON/text artifacts were read; no model weights were opened.
